xmldoc.short_description: Protobuf text format of a message.

param_input_item.param_description: a schema from protobuf.load and a message type.
one message given as a struct or as encoded uint8 bytes.

param_output_item.param_description: a character vector: the message in the protobuf text format.

description.p: protobuf.totext writes one message in the Protocol Buffers text format ("name: value", nested "name { }"), the form used by protoc --decode. protobuf.fromtext reads it back.
To display several records at once, use protobuf.show.
